# `passportsim flash_device`

Flash the connected AI Passport with a planned, confirmed and rehearsed image.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `device` |
| MCP tool | `passport_flash_device` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/flash_device` |
| Scenario step | none |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `destructive`, `native_only`, `human_confirm` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | no |

Where it does not run, `E_HOST_UNSUPPORTED` names the alternative: a real flash runs with the native CLI on the macOS or Windows host the Passport is attached to, built with feature `device`; `flash_device --dry-run` and `plan_flash` plan, refuse and report on every native host, and they open nothing

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim flash_device <image> [--backup] [--dry-run] [--erase-nvs] [--no-backup] [--port <PORT>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `backup` | `--backup` | `boolean` | no | CLI only, refused over MCP and HTTP: read the whole 8 MB part first and store it owner-only outside the repository. |
| `dry_run` | `--dry-run` | `boolean` | no | Plan only: nothing is enumerated, opened or rehearsed. |
| `erase_nvs` | `--erase-nvs` | `boolean` | no | CLI only, refused over MCP and HTTP: erase the `nvs` partition as well. |
| `image` | `<image>` | `string` | yes | A merged `.bin` of the whole 8 MB part. A build directory is refused in v1. |
| `no_backup` | `--no-backup` | `boolean` | no | CLI only: flash without the whole 8 MB backup. A real flash needs one of `--backup` or `--no-backup`, so the backup is never skipped by forgetting a flag. |
| `port` | `--port <PORT>` | `string` \| `null` | no | A discovered 303A:1001 port; required when several are attached. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/flash_device.input.json`](../schema/commands/flash_device.input.json).

## Output

Output schema: [`docs/schema/commands/flash_device.output.json`](../schema/commands/flash_device.output.json).
TypeScript types: `web/src/gen/commands/flash_device.d.ts` (`FlashDeviceArgs`, `FlashDeviceResult`).

## Errors

| Code | Number |
|---|---|
| `E_USAGE` | 1 |
| `E_HOST_UNSUPPORTED` | 19 |
| `E_PLAN_REFUSED` | 5000 |
| `E_DEVICE_BUSY` | 5001 |
| `E_CARDID_CHANGED` | 5002 |

Every code is listed in [`docs/errors.md`](../errors.md).

## Examples

### Plan and rehearse without opening the device

```sh
passportsim flash_device --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "dry_run": true,
  "image": "FoloToy-AI-Passport-8MB.bin"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "dry_run": true,
  "image": "FoloToy-AI-Passport-8MB.bin"
}
'@ | passportsim flash_device --json -
```
